_comment: Behavior shared by the macOS and Linux apps. macos/SpeaktyTests/SpecTests.swift and linux/tests/spec.rs both run every case, so the two implementations can't drift apart. Add a case here when a transcript rule changes.

replacements.name: Plain text matches whole words, ignoring case
replacements.input: Ask Co-dex about the cat, not the category.
replacements.output: Ask Codex about the $dog, not the category.

replacements.name: Patterns run in order with group templates
replacements.input: Run slash commit, then echo dollar HOME.

replacements.name: A dollar sign before a group reference is literal
Template escapes and digits after a group

spelling.name: Terms keep the case they were typed in
spelling.input: Pipewire records it, see Journalctl and CODEX.
spelling.output: PipeWire records it, see journalctl and Codex.

spelling.name: Spaces, hyphens, and underscores between a term's words are interchangeable
spelling.input: Run grill with docs, then the GitHub-actions run.
spelling.output: Run grill-with-docs, then the GitHub Actions run.

spelling.name: Only whole words match
spelling.input: Codexes read codex and agents.md, not agentsxmd.
spelling.output: Codexes read Codex and AGENTS.md, not agentsxmd.

spelling.name: The longer term wins where terms start at the same word
Separators at a term's edges are part of it

fitting.name: Unknown context leaves the text alone
A name protects its first word
A spoken new paragraph gets no space
